name: B6·3 Marketplace Intelligence — Amazon/Flipkart listing health + repricer logic + competitor watch (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step (SP-API approval involved)
**A. Amazon SP-API (free but needs registration):**
1. sellercentral.amazon.in → Apps & Services → Develop Apps → register as developer → create app → get LWA client_id/secret + refresh token (role: Pricing + Listings).
2. In n8n add an OAuth2 credential for LWA token exchange, or simply paste a valid access token into the 'Amazon: my offers' node header while testing.
3. Set variables: AMZ_MARKETPLACE_ID (India = A21TJRUUN4KGV), AMZ_SKUS (comma-separated), MIN_PRICE_<SKU> style floors in the Pricing tab (see below).

**B. Sheet tab `Pricing`:** SKU, MyPrice, FloorPrice, CompetitorPrice, LastChecked. The repricer NEVER goes below FloorPrice (jewellery margins are sacred — this is a guard, not a race).

**C. Flipkart:** Seller API needs partner onboarding (seller.flipkart.com → API access). Until then, the competitor-watch section covers Flipkart pages via public URL checks.

## HOW IT RUNS (daily 07:30)
• Pulls your offers + buy-box price per SKU (SP-API Products Pricing).
• If a competitor undercuts you AND your floor allows → suggested new price computed (competitor − 1%, never < floor) → 💰 Telegram approval card (NO auto price change — you tap to approve, then it PATCHes the listing).
• Competitor URLs list (any site incl. Flipkart) → fetched → price extracted → logged; big moves alert you.

## 🔧 FIX
• 403 from SP-API → token expired (LWA tokens live 1 h; use the OAuth credential, not a pasted token, in production).
• Wrong price parsed from competitor page → adjust the regex in 'Extract competitor price' for that site.
• Repricer too aggressive → raise floors in the Pricing tab.
